text:
People Ops: Quick policy drop  Lactation & return-to-work stipend + pumping room guidance now published: https://redwood.internal/policies/lactation-return. TL;DR below.

evelyn_peopleops: TL;DR pls?

People Ops: TL;DR  Redwood will offer a one-time Lactation Support Stipend (up to $150) for eligible caregivers returning from leave to cover supplies or a lactation consultant, plus guaranteed paid 30-min pumping breaks every 4 hours for 12 weeks post-return. Company-provided private lactation rooms will be available in SF, NYC, and LON offices; remote-first employees can claim a home setup stipend under the same benefit. Claim form and manager one-pager on the policy page. :milk:

noah_newparent: Awesome  does this apply to adoptive parents and chestfeeding?

People Ops: Yes  language is inclusive: biological lactation, chestfeeding, and adoptive parents who need pumping/feeding support are eligible. The stipend can be used for pumps, storage supplies, consultant sessions, or a temporary hands-on support service.

sam_manager: How do managers schedule coverage for the 30-min breaks? Any guidance for on-call teams?

People Ops: Managers should work with teammates to block predictable pump windows on calendars and arrange shift swaps or short coverage handoffs. For on-call or tight coverage windows, managers can request a temporary accommodation plan via the manager form; People Ops will prioritize operational continuity and the employee's needs.

benefits_team: Filing note: use GL code LCT-STD and tag claims "lactation-stipend". Upload receipts and a one-line purpose. For consultant sessions, a provider invoice is fine.

noah_newparent: Retroactive claims? I returned in Nov and didn't know about this.

People Ops: Retroactive claims accepted back to 2025-09-01. Submit receipts plus the return-to-work date and we'll process. If you already claimed a different home-setup stipend, we'll coordinate to avoid duplicates.

payroll_bot: Important: stipend may be taxable in some jurisdictions. The claim confirmation will include tax treatment by region. If taxable, payroll will withhold accordingly.

linda_wellness: We partnered with a lactation consultant network for discounted virtual consults. Book through the vendor link on the policy page and use code REDWOOD-LACT for one free 30-min intro consult.

sam_manager: Contractors? Are they covered?

People Ops: This benefit is for full-time Redwood employees only. Contractors can access the vendor referral network at discounted rates but are not eligible for the stipend or paid pumping break time.

noah_newparent: Privacy question: does People Ops see medical details?

People Ops: Only minimal info is required (return date, brief reason if requesting accommodations). Medical details are not required for the stipend. Any medical documentation provided is stored in HRIS with restricted access. We recommend redacting sensitive details when possible.

evelyn_peopleops: Ops bot will publish the policy and attach the manager one-pager now.

ops_bot: Published: https://redwood.internal/policies/lactation-return  Form: https://redwood.internal/forms/lactation-stipend. Manager one-pager attached. For urgent cases DM People Ops with subject "URGENT LACTATION SUPPORT".

People Ops: We'll host a 20-min Q&A next Wednesday at 12pm PT for managers and returning parents. Invite posted in #people-ops-calendar. Thanks all  we're aiming to make transitions smoother.
